name: Byōdō-in: doors
_about: The Phoenix Hall: the core's double plank doors (itatobira) on battens, red with gilt nail heads -- three on the front, one on each side's front bay; the double door in the walled back of the skirt; the corner towers' plank doors; the tail corridor's sliding doors. The skirt's front and sides and the wings' ground storeys are open between their posts, the core's back side bays open

doors._about: the core's plank doors (its open back bays are left open)
the double door in the skirt's walled back, into the tail corridor
the tail corridor's sliding doors in its first bay
